messages:
anya: Quick check — we started the crowdsourced anchor instrumentation run for the new q4b onboarding. Posting this thread so label ops + sampling are in the loop.

carl: thanks — did we sample from both seedbank A and B or just A?

anya: both. proportions: 60% A, 40% B to stress the longtail. sampler code used: `sample_p=0.6 --cohort A,B --dedupe fuzzyhash:0.94`.

leo: can you paste the small sampling snippet? want to reproduce the microbatch locally.

anya: sure —
```
python infra/samplebank/runner.py \
  --cohorts A,B \
  --p 0.6 \
  --strategy crowd-anchor \
  --window 72h \
  --dedupe-method fuzzyhash:0.94
```

rachel: heads up — labeler capacity is low this afternoon (queue len 38). can we drop a soft-priority flag for anchors so we don't block golden refresh?

anya: good call. adding `prio:soft` tag to anchor microbatches. also toggled `label-routing: overlap-guard` to avoid duplicate assignments.

labeler-bot: queue-status: 38 pending, ETA ~4h at current throughput. reacting with :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

carl: for instrumentation — did we attach the model variant metadata? need model, quant, kernel_profile in payload so evals can slice.

anya: yes: payload schema includes `model_name`, `model_hash`, `quant_mode`, `kernel_profile`, `seed_cohort`. example: `{model_name: q4b-large, model_hash: ab12cd, quant_mode: int4, kernel_profile: sparse-optim, seed_cohort: A}`.

leo: perfect. will run a local smoke: 200 samples through q4b int4 and compare tokenization diffs. will ping results here.

rachel: can we also attach `deid_flag` and `orig_source` to help curation? last time we missed a handful and had to re-run.

anya: added both fields to the payload. also created a small validation check: `validate_payload --must-have deid_flag,orig_source,model_hash` — it fails fast.

carl: FYI I'm going to kick off a dedupe pass on the microbatch with a tighter threshold for longform (0.92) to reduce paraphrase noise.

leo: note for evals: when you run the quality regressor, set `n_samples=500` and use the holdout golden set for A/B. prefer bootstrap CI.

anya: logging plan: we'll log `prompt_id, anchor_id, model_hash, quant_mode, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, label_id, label_rationale` to s3 path `s3://redwood-curation/crowd-inst/6932102468/`. rachel can you confirm retention policy?

rachel: retention OK for 90 days for microbatches. golden-linked artifacts we snapshot to long-term after vetting.

labeler-bot: microbatch 6932102468 registered. job-id cw-inst-6932. status: sampling complete, 1 dedupe job queued.

carl: thanks all. once dedupe finishes I'll mark the batch `ready-for-golden` and schedule a 1h review with ops tomorrow 09:30 PT.

anya: awesome — timeline: dedupe (~30m), label routing (~5m), validation (~5m), then review. will update thread if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
